overview_description.description:
Leah, formerly ContractPodAi, empowers enterprises to build, orchestrate, and govern intelligent AI agents across legal, procurement, finance, and beyond through Leah Agentic OS and Leah Agentic CLM  (Contract Lifecycle Management). 

Founded on elevating human judgment rather than replacing it, Leah automates complex workflows, connects data silos, and drives measurable ROI at scale. 

Our foundation rests on four pillars:  

Lead - Always one step ahead, bringing customers along with us.  

Empower - Built to help employees do their very best work.  

Accelerate - Streamlines and accelerates your enterprise's most desirable outcomes.  

Harmonize - Evolves to bring people and processes into perfect harmony. 

Trusted by global enterprises, Leah delivers competitive advantage through AI-driven automation and operational excellence. Partnerships with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, Meta, Cohere, and Mistral strengthen our technological foundation. 

With offices in London, New York, Dubai, Sydney, Glasgow, Mumbai, and Singapore, Leah continues expanding globally.

about_short_description.short_description: Leah, formerly ContractPodAi, provides agentic AI solutions that harmonize workflows, empower teams, and unleash enterprise potential.

product.name: Leah Agentic OS
product.description: An AI-native enterprise operating system that coordinates specialized agents to execute multi-step legal, contracting, procurement, finance, and commercial workflows.

product.name: Leah Maestro
product.description: An enterprise orchestration product that coordinates AI agents, workflows, applications, and connected business systems to execute commercial processes end to end.

product.name: Leah Agentic CLM
product.description: An agentic contract lifecycle management platform covering contract intake, creation, review, negotiation, approval, signature, repository management, obligations, and renewals.

product.name: Leah Legal
product.description: A domain-specific AI solution for legal risk intelligence, compliance, matter management, regulatory response, and legal workflow automation.

product.name: Leah Procurement
product.description: An AI-driven procurement and source-to-pay solution that connects sourcing, supplier onboarding, approvals, spend analytics, and negotiations to contract obligations and legal exposure.

product.name: Leah Finance
product.description: A commercial finance automation solution that connects contract obligations with spend controls, order-to-cash, treasury, payables, receivables, and financial operations.
